question: Which paper proves room-temperature self-healing in the amber polymer lattice?

candidate_papers.title: Amber polymer lattice simulation
candidate_papers.text: The simulation proposes an amber polymer lattice but explicitly omits room-temperature self-healing experiments.

candidate_papers.title: Room-temperature sensor packaging
candidate_papers.text: This packaging note mentions room-temperature testing for sensors and provides no polymer lattice healing claim.

candidate_papers.title: Optical color in lattice films
candidate_papers.text: A materials paper measures amber coloration in lattice films without self-healing evidence.
